title: Extension Guide Home
desc: US federal, state, and local tax extension reference. An extension to file is not an extension to pay tax.

title: Federal Extensions Hub
desc: Every federal extension form in one place: 4868, 7004, 8868, 4768, 8809.

title: Form 4868 Individual Extension
desc: Automatic 6-month extension for Form 1040, 1040-NR, dual-status. IRC 6081, Treas. Reg. 1.6081-4.

title: Form 7004 Business Extension
desc: Automatic 6-month extension for 1120, 1120-S, 1065, 1041, 1042. Treas. Reg. 1.6081-3.

title: Form 8868 Nonprofit Extension
desc: Automatic 6-month extension for Form 990 series and Form 5330.

title: Form 4768 Estate Tax Extension
desc: Automatic filing extension and discretionary payment extension for Form 706 under IRC 6161.

title: Form 8809 Information Returns Extension
desc: Automatic 30-day extension for W-2, 1099, 1098, 1095 and other information returns. W-2 not automatic.

title: Special Situations
desc: Taxpayers abroad, Form 2350, combat zone relief, disaster postponements.

title: How to Paper File
desc: Timely-mailing rule, proof of mailing, Where to File addresses.

title: How to E-File
desc: IRS Free File, IRS e-file, and commercial extension services.

title: Penalties & Interest
desc: Failure-to-file, failure-to-pay, and interest rules and current rates.

title: State Extensions Hub
desc: State-by-state extension rules. California, New York, Texas, Florida, Illinois live now.

title: California Tax Extension
desc: Individual and business extensions, both automatic. Cal. Code Regs. tit. 18 sect 18567; R&TC sect 18604.

title: New York Tax Extension
desc: Form IT-370 individual, Form CT-5 corporate. N.Y. Tax Law sect 657, sect 1085.

title: Texas Franchise Tax Extension
desc: No individual income tax. Form 05-164, not automatic. 34 Tex. Admin. Code sect 3.585.

title: Florida Corporate Income Tax Extension
desc: No individual income tax. Form F-7004, not automatic, 100% payment due. Fla. Stat. sect 220.222.

title: Illinois Tax Extension
desc: Individual and corporate extensions, both automatic. 35 ILCS 5/505; 86 Ill. Admin. Code sect 100.5020.

title: Pennsylvania Tax Extension
desc: Semi-automatic extension, REV-276 if tax owed. 61 Pa. Code sect 117.14.

title: New Jersey Tax Extension
desc: Form NJ-630, not automatic, 80% payment condition. N.J.A.C. 18:35-6.1.

title: Massachusetts Tax Extension
desc: Form M-4868, 80% payment condition for individuals/fiduciaries. M.G.L. c. 62C sect 19.

title: Ohio Tax Extension
desc: Fully automatic, matches federal extension, no separate form. Ohio Rev. Code sect 5747.08.

title: Washington State Tax Extension
desc: No individual or corporate income tax. B&O excise extension is discretionary. WAC 458-20-228.

title: Oregon Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension; corporations use federal Form 7004. Or. Rev. Stat. sect 314.385.

title: Georgia Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension; Form IT-303 otherwise. O.C.G.A. sect 48-7-57.

title: North Carolina Tax Extension
desc: Automatic with federal extension; Form D-410 otherwise, 90% payment rule. N.C. Gen. Stat. sect 105-263.

title: Virginia Tax Extension
desc: Automatic, no application, 90% payment rule to avoid penalty. Va. Code sect 58.1-344.

title: Michigan Tax Extension
desc: Not automatic, Form 4 plus estimated payment required. Mich. Comp. Laws sect 206.311.

title: Master Extension Matrix
desc: Sortable table of every jurisdiction and tax type.

title: FAQ
desc: Common extension questions answered.

title: Disclaimer
desc: Site disclaimer and terms.
